Deferred to the docs pass (out of Track K ship scope), from the Wave A/B handoffs:

- `docs/guide/desktop-helper.qmd` — new guide for Captain Hook.app (install via the
  `captain-hook` cask — token renamed from `capt-hook-helper` in 045650d6, fully
  qualified as `brew install --cask yasyf/tap/captain-hook`; `capt-hook helper
  install|status|notify`, notification permissions, the widget); cross-link from
  `session-reviewer.qmd`. writing-docs + slop-cop + great-docs build.
- `captain_hook/skills/scanning-sessions/SKILL.md` — Step 7 checklist and the numbered
  "Record" step still show the bare `review update <ID> pr_open --pr-url <url>` stamp;
  add `--pr-title "<title>"` so the brain always passes a title (references/pr-workflow.md
  and review-cli.md are already updated).
- Release runbook note: the helper release job needs the two provisioning profiles
  "Captain Hook Helper App" / "Captain Hook Helper Widget" (App Group
  SXKCTF23Q2.com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper) to exist in the Apple dev account before the
  first tagged release; that release also proves the release-app cask PUBLISH path
  (session task #17).
